pages.text: The Mirror shows your jewelry: your first Curios ring, bracelet and necklace slot. Put jewelry in here or in the Curios screen; either way it is worn. Right click to open it; each opening costs one of its 100 uses. The plain Mirror does not enchant.
pages.title: Mirror

pages.text: The Magic Mirror also enchants. Put an item in its fourth slot and pick one of three levels, paid in experience levels, like an enchanting table. It starts at levels 1-3; sneak and right click to move up three levels at a time, up to 30, after which it wraps back to 1-3. It is repaired on an anvil with any pearl.
pages.title: Magic Mirror

pages.text: Pearls enchanted in a mirror lean towards the enchantment their colour favours, and they only roll jewelry enchantments. Books turn into enchanted books.
The Celestial Mirror works like the Magic Mirror but enchants at levels 31-60, which some enchantments need. It is repaired with magic droplets.
pages.title: Celestial Mirror
